info.name: ICE BLUE CHATGPT
info.description:
? Soft & Cool Look: The background is a gentle ice blue, making everything feel calm and refreshing—like a peaceful winter morning.

? Clean Chat Bubbles: Your messages have a deeper blue tint, while ChatGPT’s responses are lighter and airy, creating a nice contrast.

? Soft Sage Green Accents: Buttons and borders have a muted sage green to keep the theme balanced and elegant, adding a touch of warmth.

? Crisp Dark Blue Text: Instead of plain black, the text is a rich navy blue—easy on the eyes and sophisticated.

? Minimalist & Modern: No harsh shadows, no clutter—just smooth, rounded corners and a translucent, airy design that keeps everything looking light and sleek.

? Bonus: The scrollbar disappears for a cleaner, more immersive experience!

Basically, it’s chill, aesthetic, and easy on the eyes, perfect if you love cool tones with a subtle, elegant contrast. ❄️✨
